rows.summary: Pages are numbered from 1, but the slice start treated page as zero-based, so page 1 returned the second chunk. Use (page - 1) * size so page 1 starts at index 0.

rows.kind: sort: direction, tie-break and no mutation
rows.summary: Return a copy of players sorted by score highest first, and by name A to Z when scores are equal, so the original array is not mutated.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: withDefaults now copies into a new object and applies caller options after defaults, so given values win and the input is not mutated.
Key the memoization cache on every argument, not only the first, so a different second argument is not served the first call's result.
Await all fetchOne results so loadAll resolves to a list of values instead of a list of Promises.
Require a dot in the domain so isEmail('a@b') is false, while dotted addresses such as a@b.co still match.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in its definition, export, import, and call site under apps/web/src.
On get, move a hit to the end of the Map so a just-read entry counts as recently used and is not the one evicted when the cache is full.
formatDuration now uses remainders so minutes and seconds are not the raw total (3725 becomes 1h 2m 5s).
parseAge now throws a RangeError whose message contains 'invalid age' for non-numeric values, negatives, and ages over 150, and still returns the number for valid ages.
Fix cart subtotal so each item is charged price times quantity instead of once.
removeAt now copies the list before splicing, so it returns a new list without that item and leaves the caller's list unchanged.
Pages are numbered from 1, but the slice start used a zero-based index, so page 1 returned the second chunk. Subtract one from the page before multiplying by size so page 1 starts at the first item.

rows.kind: sort: direction, tie-break and no mutation
rows.summary: Return a copy of players sorted by score highest first, then by name A to Z when scores are equal, without mutating the input array.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: withDefaults now copies defaults into a new object and then applies the caller's values, so caller settings win and the input object is not mutated.

Memoize was caching only on the first argument, so a later call with the same first argument and a different second argument returned the first result. Key the cache on all arguments so each distinct argument list is stored separately.
loadAll mapped ids to fetchOne calls and returned the promises themselves. Promise.all waits for every fetch so callers receive the resolved values.
Require a dot in the domain part of isEmail so addresses like a@b are rejected while dotted domains still match.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in its definition, export, and the greeting.js call site under apps/web/src.
On get, move a hit to the end of the Map so a just-read entry is most recently used and is not the one evicted when the cache is full.
Fix formatDuration so minutes and seconds are remainders, not the unreduced total. 3725 becomes 1h 2m 5s.
parseAge now throws RangeError('invalid age') for NaN, negatives, and values over 150, and still returns valid ages as numbers.
Multiply each item's price by its quantity in the cart subtotal so buying the same item more than once is charged for every unit.
removeAt copied the list before splicing so the caller's list is left unchanged and a new list without that item is returned.
